← THE DECLARATIONARTICLE I OF XXXVII
GRIEVANCE I ◆ ECONOMIC STEWARDSHIP

He has imposed sweeping import taxes whose costs have fallen chiefly upon American households and businesses.

THE RECORD SHOWS

Federal Reserve research finds U.S. firms and consumers bore most of the cost of the 2025 tariffs, which also raised consumer prices.

New York Fed researchers estimated that nearly 90% of the 2025 tariff burden reached U.S. import prices, while Federal Reserve Board economists estimated a 0.8% increase in core personal-consumption prices through February 2026 attributable to tariffs. A separate 2026 Supreme Court decision invalidated the emergency-powers basis for major tariffs. The administration argues tariffs protect American industries and raise revenue; these studies measure costs rather than deciding the net long-run effects of every trade measure.

A DOCUMENTED SEQUENCE

3 MILESTONES
  1. 2025The effective U.S. import tariff rate rose sharply as new levies took effect.
  2. February 2026New York Fed researchers found that almost nine-tenths of tariffs passed into prices paid by U.S. importers.
  3. April 2026Federal Reserve Board economists estimated measurable tariff-driven increases in consumer-goods prices.
